gameName: Eclipse: Second Dawn for the Galaxy

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Eclipse: Second Dawn for the Galaxy rulebook (Lautapelit.fi)

steps.text: Draw Tech Tiles from the bag until {n} regular ones are out; slot them by type and cost, Rare tiles on the bottom row (not counted)
Reputation Tiles shuffled in their bag; Discovery Tiles shuffled facedown
One Blueprint Tile each for Ancients, Guardians and the GCDS; Ship Part Tiles sorted in the Upgrade Tray
steps.note: Tiles with two notches are advanced

steps.text: Galactic Center in the middle with a facedown Discovery Tile and the GCDS miniature on top
Shuffle Inner, Middle and Outer Sectors into facedown stacks; the Outer stack holds {n} Sectors
Fill empty Starting Zones with random Guardian Sectors, each with a facedown Discovery Tile and a Guardian miniature
Start Player Tile to whoever has spent the least time on Terra
From the player to the Start Player's right, counterclockwise: pick a Species Board and tray; Starting Sector in the nearest Starting Zone, arrow toward the center
Colony Ships as your Species Board shows; Summary Tile; Influence Discs on the Influence Track (3 extra stay in the tray)
Population Cubes on squares 3-28 of the three Population Tracks; Storage Markers at your starting values
Starting Sector: 1 Interceptor, a Population Cube on each square without a star, 1 Influence Disc from the left of your track

details: No special rules: the standard species
Draw 2 random Reputation Tiles face down before the game
Start with 2 fewer Influence Discs (leave the two leftmost spaces empty)
Interceptor, Cruiser and Dreadnought blueprints produce extra energy
Setup: a Population Cube in the Advanced Science square of the Starting Sector
Opponent Ships destroy your Population Cubes automatically at the end of the Combat Phase
+1 VP per Controlled Sector at game end
Blueprints: lower Initiative, extra computers and energy, one less Ship Part space
Explore: flip two Sectors per activation and place one (or none); the rest are discarded face up
+1 VP per Ancient on the board at game end
Ships and Influence Discs may share Sectors with Ancients (no battle), but no Discovery Tiles from them
Cheaper building: Interceptor 2, Cruiser 4, Dreadnought 7, Starbase 2, Orbital 3, Monolith 8
3 activations per Upgrade and per Build action
Start with a Cruiser instead of an Interceptor
All blueprints have higher Initiative; Interceptor, Cruiser and Dreadnought produce extra energy

steps.text: The Start Player takes the first action; play continues clockwise
